On the right, the shirtless blonde man (R1) stands in profile facing left, raising his hand defensively in a playful gesture. In the background, tiny blurred bystanders dot the distant shoreline under a clear sky. Bright, direct sunlight casts soft shadows on their athletic builds, highlighting the warm sand and blue ocean.
